def transform(grid):

    legend = [grid[1][1], grid[1][7], grid[1][13], grid[1][19]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid[6:]]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in out for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    def bbox(color):
        q = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if out[r][c] == color]
        if not q:
            return None
        return (min(r for r, c in q), max(r for r, c in q),
                min(c for r, c in q), max(c for r, c in q))

    boxes = [bbox(color) for color in legend]
    seed = bbox(8)
    ys, _, xs, xe = seed
    t = seed[1] - ys + 1
    left = next(box for box in boxes if box and box[2] == 0 and box[0] > 0)
    bottom = next(box for box in boxes if box and box[1] == h - 1)
    right_candidates = [box for box in boxes if box and box[2] > xe]
    right = max(right_candidates, key=lambda box: box[2]) if right_candidates else None
    has_top = any(box and box[0] == 0 and box[2] > 0 for box in boxes)

    xl = left[3] + 1
    yb = bottom[0] - t
    xr = right[2] - t if right is not None else xs
    yt = 0 if has_top else ys

    def paint(rs, cs):
        for r in rs:
            for c in cs:
                if 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and out[r][c] == bg:
                    out[r][c] = 8

    paint(range(yt, yb + t), range(xl, xl + t))
    paint(range(yt, yb + t), range(xs, xs + t))
    paint(range(yt, ys + t), range(xr, xr + t))
    paint(range(ys, ys + t), range(xl, xr + t))
    paint(range(yb, yb + t), range(xl, xs + t))
    if has_top:
        paint(range(yt, yt + t), range(xl, xr + t))
    return out

    seed = box(8)
    ys, yend, xs, xe = seed

    yt = top[1] + 1 if top else 0

                    out[r][c] = 8

    paint(range(yt, yb + thickness), range(xl, xl + thickness))
    paint(range(0, yb + thickness), range(xs, xs + thickness))
    paint(range(0, ys + thickness), range(xr, xr + thickness))
